PROFILE
Physiotherapist for sixteen years and clinic director for the last seven. Fellow of the Canadian Academy of
Manipulative Physiotherapy. I lead a clinic of 12 clinicians, mentor residents, and still treat complex spine and
shoulder patients two days a week.
EXPERIENCE
Clinic Director and Senior Physiotherapist - Rideau Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation, Ottawa, ON | 2019 - Present
- Lead 12 clinicians (physiotherapy, massage, kinesiology); clinic revenue up 40% since 2019.
- Built a vestibular rehab and concussion program; clinical mentor for orthopaedic residents.
